_ytflow_note: VERIFIED 2026-08-08 (Story 10.1b), live single-pair probe SCP-049 x containment-chamber (plate workspace/8a9a288b-.../images/scene_002_S00202.png), output at _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/10-1b-live-validation/probe/. WHAT WAS WRONG (the 2026-08-02 park said 'IC-Light v1 is photoreal-trained and these cards are flat anime' — that was a hypothesis; these two are measurements): (1) the foreground latent was node 1 straight out of LoadImage, whose convert("RGB") zeroes the alpha channel — 71.65% of this card's pixels are alpha<8 with RGB exactly [0,0,0], so fbc was conditioned on a subject in a black void, which is precisely the 'near-black' the old probe reported. Now node 21 mattes the card onto #7F7F7F first, as kijai's own fbc example does. (2) the init latent was ICLightConditioning's third output, which is torch.zeros_like, sampled at denoise 0.85 — neither a relight nor a generation. Now node 23 encodes a LightSource gradient at denoise 1.0, matching the example. Also fixed outside this file: _inject_relight_inputs used to submit these two top-level metadata keys as if they were nodes, and ComfyUI's validate_prompt does `'class_type' not in prompt[x]` — a bool there raises TypeError and every submission came back 500. PROBE RESULT: alpha correlation to the source silhouette +1.0000, max alpha diff 0/255, canvas 832x1216 unchanged; in-silhouette mean RGB moved 42.7/42.8/55.1 (L=46.8, cool) -> 30.1/26.2/37.8 (L=31.4), i.e. 4.7 levels of blue-minus-red toward the plate's warm cast (plate as fbc sees it, centre-cropped to 832x1216: 77.9/69.2/68.2, L=71.8). No washing, no monochrome, line art and pose intact. KNOWN LIMITS: the card comes back darker than the unlit sprite while the plate region it lands in is brighter, because node 11 centre-crops the whole plate rather than the local band under the card (the cache key is card x location, not shot, so the local band is not knowable here). And light_position is effectively inert: at denoise 1.0 ComfyUI ignores the init latent's content, so 'Top Light' vs 'Top Left Light' measured dL=0.6 and <=0.8 per channel — within sampler variance. The node is kept because the official example keeps it and it fixes the latent shape.
